items.alt: Opal on an Android phone in landscape: Sintel fills the screen edge to edge with a subtitle line and a single compact control bar showing play, time, seek bar, audio, subtitles and more.
items.caption: Opal now runs on Android. Immersive landscape playback with a compact, auto-hiding control bar and subtitles, captured on a OnePlus 12 (Android 16) while streaming Sintel by torrent. Sintel © Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0.
